V2-C012.rule: Authoritative cash-session calendar + strict same-timestamp observed US500/NAS100 M15 intersection. Rolling state advances only on synchronized completed observations; next common valid observed M15 open is entry.

V2-C009.rule: Accepted BTCUSD H1 event stream retains real missing bars. Candidate is session-agnostic and operates on completed observed events only; missing intervals are not fabricated.

V2-C007.rule: Accepted XAUUSD H4 timestamps are the observed executable event partition. Candidate uses completed observed H4 bars and first later valid observed H4 open; DST/session partition shifts are carried by observed timestamps and no missing H4 bar is fabricated.
